essentialEvidence: Verify the complete September 2026 Brain Science curriculum, unit credits and applicable progression, minor, project and thesis requirements from current official course and regulation evidence.
officialAlternative: Followed the current curriculum link to programme EN/52637834. Searched official Maastricht pages and regulations, inspected the 2025 EER effective period, and followed the official faculty exchange guidance to the AskPsy regulations link. AskPsy reports login-required successor intranet. Three plausible 2026 EER URLs returned 404. No university contact was made.

sources.finding: Current official page explicitly identifies its curriculum as 2026–2027 and links to the course repository. Previous-year PDFs are explicitly archived. The page confirms English, full time and September intake.
The linked programme URL returned only a Mendix application shell. Web retrieval redirected to the repository root and returned a JavaScript requirement, with no course or credit records.

The EER is adopted 20 May 2025 and effective for the 2025–2026 academic year. It does not establish adoption for 2026–2027. Its complete earlier 180 EC reconstruction is preserved without asserting that it applies to September 2026 entrants.
Official faculty exchange guidance links to AskPsy for study programme EERs. It is a discovery route, not programme-specific 2026 evidence.
AskPsy /regulations redirects to a 401 notice. It directs readers to the FPN student intranet and states that login is required.

The official minor page lists 30 EC minor choices and Board approval, but its current application dates concern 2027–2028. Programme-level choices remain valuable research context, while their cohort applicability needs current regulation confirmation.

disposition: First unsuccessful essential-source execution. Incomplete, with no deferral or approval.
